UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public profile and theme preferences for an authenticated WikiLink Assistant editor.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Display name of the Wikipedia editor.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII document storing the user's private email address.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the private record was updated.

RegisteredEmailLock.title: RegisteredEmailLock
RegisteredEmailLock.description: Global email uniqueness lock ensuring that once an email has signed in, no other user can create a duplicate account with that email.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID that owns this email.

displayName.description: Member display name associated with this account.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the email was first claimed.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the email lock was last verified.

ActivityLog.title: ActivityLog
ActivityLog.description: Individual Wikipedia article analysis and contamination repair log entry owned by a user.

logId.description: Unique identifier of the log entry.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who created the log.

action.description: Type of action performed (e.g. article analysis, contamination fix, login).

lang.description: Wikipedia language code (e.g. hi, en, sa).

newLinks.description: Count of new wikilinks added or suggested.

contaminationsFixed.description: Count of contaminated links diagnosed or fixed.

note.description: Summary note about the analysis session.

wikitext.description: Optional snapshot of wikitext (truncated to 50,000 chars for Firestore safety).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the log entry was created.

BlacklistRequest.title: BlacklistRequest
BlacklistRequest.description: User-submitted request to add a non-linkable word to the global blacklist, pending approval by Admin Vikram Pratap.

requestId.description: Unique identifier of the blacklist request.

term.description: Original word or phrase requested for exclusion.

termLower.description: Normalized lowercase form of the word.

articleTitle.description: Article context where the word was encountered.

reason.description: Rationale for excluding the word from wikilinks.

requestedByUid.description: UID of the user who submitted the request.

requestedByName.description: Display name of the requesting user.

reviewedByEmail.description: Email of the admin who reviewed the request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the request was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the request was last updated.

ApprovedBlacklistWord.title: ApprovedBlacklistWord
ApprovedBlacklistWord.description: Globally active non-linkable word approved by Admin Vikram Pratap.

wordId.description: Document identifier for the approved word.

requestedByName.description: Name of the member who proposed or added the word.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores public profile and theme settings for each authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/private/{infoId}.description: Stores isolated PII (email) accessible strictly by the document owner.

/users/{userId}/activityLogs/{logId}.description: Subcollection of Wikipedia article analysis and wikilink activity logs belonging to the user.

/registeredEmails/{emailKey}.description: Stores email ownership locks so no duplicate account can be created with an already signed-in email.

/blacklistRequests/{requestId}.description: Stores user requests to add words to the blacklist awaiting Admin approval.

/approvedBlacklist/{wordId}.description: Stores Admin-approved blacklist words displayed and enforced across the tool.
